headline: War against piracy starts in schools
content: The Ministry of Production has initiated campaigns in high school classrooms across seventeen regions aiming for over 25 thousand students to reject counterfeit products and respect intellectual property rights. This initiative includes workshops like Decide, Respect: Reject Counterfeit Products which aim to instill positive attitudes towards copyright among young people.

headline: No lobby influence, says Prime Cabinet Chief
content: Prime Cabinet Chief Ana Jara dismissed negotiations between ministers due to personal interests while President Nadine Heredia requested Congress give her government confidence vote.

headline: Brazil presidential candidate dies in plane crash
content: Eduardo Campos, Brazilian Socialist Party’s presidential hopeful who was third in polls, died along with six others after his aircraft crashed near São Paulo during heavy rain conditions. His death prompts political uncertainty under Brazils election laws requiring PSB to nominate another candidate within ten days.

headline: Depression discussion following Robin Williams’ suicide
content: Robin Williams tragic passing sparked global discussions about depression, highlighting its prevalence even amongst renowned comedians. Despite numerous studies confirming widespread ignorance and prejudice regarding mental health issues such as depression, there remains significant stigma preventing many individuals from seeking help.

headline: Congress defines commission presidents
content: During yesterdays session, the Peruvian congress unanimously approved the formation of twenty-four commissions proportional to party representation. Notably, Enrique Wong from Solidarity National leads the contentious Audit Commission despite opposition claims questioning their independence.

headline: Export growth prospects improve amid U.S economic recovery
content: Due to improved second-quarter performance in the United States, exports including fishery and agricultural goods have seen substantial increases. Analysts anticipate further demand rise benefiting traditional exporters amidst ongoing trade relations improvements.

headline: Threat persists of major earthquake in northern Chile
content: Recent research published suggests continued risk of large-scale earthquakes exceeding magnitude 8.5 in Northern Chile, particularly given recent seismic activities around Iquique area indicating potential stress accumulation since last notable quake in 1877.

headline: Comunicado sobre liderazgos en conflicto
content: Haniye agregó que dio a la delegación negociadora palestina en El Cairo.  Se estima que unos dos mil muertos ha causado el conflicto desde el pasado 8 de julio.

headline: Nuevo hallazgo médico revela cómo el virus evita el sistema inmunitario humano
content: Durante mucho tiempo hemos sabido que la infección con el virus del ébola obstruye una importante molécula de inmunidad llamada interferón, señaló Gayatri Amarasinghe en la revista Cell Host & Microbe. Ahora que conocemos cómo el virus del ébola impide la respuesta de inmunidad, podemos orientar el desarrollo de nuevos tratamientos para llegar a la cura.

headline: Tenistas internacionales buscan consolidarse en torneos importantes
content: Roger Federer continúa acumulando récords mientras Andy Murray y John Isner también hacen notables actuaciones en el Abierto de Cincinnati.
